title: Stockholm's Strawberry Arena Hosts Bad Bunny as "DtMF" Extends Its Own Record to 67th Week at No. 1
detail: Bad Bunny plays two nights at Strawberry Arena in Stockholm (July 10–11, 2026), with 'Mr. October' and 'Agosto' as the exclusive songs. The same week, Billboard's Hot Latin Songs chart dated July 11, 2026 confirms 'DtMF' at No. 1 for a 67th consecutive week — extending the all-time record it set in May by five more weeks. The chart remains Bad Bunny-dominated: 'DtMF' leads, with 'Baile Inolvidable,' 'Nuevayol,' 'Eoo,' 'Ayúdame,' and 'Voy a Llevarte Pa PR' also charting in the top 10, and Eslabon Armado & Peso Pluma debuting at No. 7.
